description: Agency moved to broad-reach bidding. CPL fell ~35% and volume tripled, but the leads sit outside ICP. Cohorts acquired after this date churn ~2.3x faster and sign ~22% smaller.
GA of Multi-Warehouse Sync. Enterprise accounts start adding sites. Shows up as expansion MRR and NRR, not as new logos.
+18% list price applied to SMB accounts at their renewal anniversary. Realised ARPA rises; gross churn spikes for four months and then settles at a permanently higher plateau.
SDR headcount went from 4 to 9. Total meetings rose; meetings per rep fell about 27%. This is the only direct evidence available on what SDR #10 through #18 would actually produce.
Co-sell agreement with two 3PL platforms. Best LTV/CAC in the book, but volume is capped by partner-side AE availability.
Cut-over to the new billing engine double-posted one month of invoices and back-dated a batch of credit memos. Data defect only, no economics.
